d: Large courtyard of Fabrizio's house. On the front overlooks a rustic portico with a pergola; on a pillar is hung an open cage, inside of which you can see a magpie. In the bottom and towards the middle there is a door with a gate, so you enter the courtyard. Beyond the scene represents some hills. Several residents of the village; some families carrying the necessary things to set up a canteen; immediately Pippo; then Lucia with a basket.
Ninetta with a strawberry sandwich, which goes down from the hill and enters the courtyard; Poscia Fabrizio; and finally Lucia with the basket of cutlery.
Isaac, before he goes inside and faces the gate, with his chest of goods; and immediately Pippo, doing something for the table.
Pippo and Ninetta with flowers to adorn the canteen.
Ninetta, Pippo, Giannetto, Fabrizio, Lucia, Contadini and Contadini who see themselves descending from the hill, and the Fabrizio Family who come out in the courtyard.
Ninetta, and now Fernando.
The Podestà, Ninetta and Fernando.
George and sayings.
The Podestà, Ninetta and Fernando.
Ground room in Fabrizio's house, at the bottom a door with windows that look on the street. Pippo, then Ninetta who comes from the courtyard with basket of cutlery; and finally Isaac.
Ninetta and Pippo carrying the cage of the magpie.
Ninetta; immediately Giannetto, and Poscia Fabrizio, both from the door that puts to the street.
Lucia who brings back Ninetta; the Podestà, the Chancellor and sayings; finally Pippo.
Pippo and sayings.
Pippo with Isaac and sayings.
The above; Gregory at the head of the People of Arms; many village dwellers and all the Family of Fabrizio.
Vestibule of the prisons in the Podestria. Antonio, and immediately Ninetta.
Ninetta; then again Antonio, and finally Giannetto outside.
Giannetto and sayings.
Antonio hasty, and sayings.
Antonio; immediately the Podestà; poses Ninetta, and finally some Guards.
Antonio, Ninetta, and now Pippo.
Earthly room in Fabrizio's house, as in the first act. Lucia sola.
Lucia and Fernando.

Hall of the court in the podesteria. Praetor, Judges, an Exit; the Podestà, Giannetto; Fabrizio; People; Guards at the gates. Judges are seated on their seats; in the middle of them is the Praetor, before whom is placed a coffee table. - The Podestà present at the session, occupies a chair apart. - On the one hand you see the People spectator, among whom are Giannetto and Fabrizio.
Ninette and sayings.
Fernando entering impetuously, and sayings.

Piazza del Villaggio. To the right of the viewer you can see the bell tower and part of the church: towards the top of the bell tower protrudes out a small bridge used to make repairs. - To the left is placed the main door of the podestria. Beyond the podestria there is a contrada, and opposite another that puts behind the church. Similarly to the left, you see a small door, which is that of the garden of the house of Fabrizio. Lucia.
Ernesto, and now Pippo.
Pippo, then Giorgio and finally Antonio.
Ninelet in the midst of the People of Arms; Farmers, and George who has withdrawn into a corner and who expresses his sorrow.
Giorgio; Pippo and Antonio in the bell tower; and Poscia Giannetto, Fabrizio, Lucia and several Family.
The Podestà and above, except Giannetto and Fabrizio.
The above, Ninetta, Fabrizio, Giannetto, Abitanti, Gente d'arme; and poses Ernesto with Fernando.
